templateModal.title: Fine Templates
templateModal.description: Select a policy or misconduct template to prefill the reason and era-adjusted amount.

templates.name: Regular Season Technical Fouls 1–5
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the regular-season progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Regular Season Technical Fouls 6–10
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the regular-season progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Regular Season Technical Fouls 11–15
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the regular-season progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Regular Season Technical Foul 16
templates.reason: Automatic fine and one-game suspension for the sixteenth regular-season technical foul.

templates.name: Additional Regular Season Technical Foul
templates.reason: Automatic fine for each regular-season technical foul after the sixteenth; every second additional technical also carries a one-game suspension.

templates.name: Playoff Technical Fouls 1–2
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the playoff progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Playoff Technical Fouls 3–4
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the playoff progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Playoff Technical Fouls 5–6
templates.reason: Automatic fine under the playoff progressive technical-foul schedule.

templates.name: Playoff Technical Foul 7
templates.reason: Automatic fine and one-game suspension for the seventh playoff technical foul.

templates.name: Additional Playoff Technical Foul
templates.reason: Automatic fine for each playoff technical foul after the seventh; every second additional technical also carries a one-game suspension.

templates.name: First Ejection
templates.reason: Automatic fine for a first ejection under the progressive ejection schedule.

templates.name: Subsequent Ejection
templates.reason: Automatic progressive ejection fine, increasing by the era-adjusted equivalent of $2,000 after each prior ejection.

templates.name: Deliberate Rim Hanging
templates.reason: Deliberately hanging on the basket ring without the action being necessary to prevent injury.

templates.name: Flagrant Foul — Penalty 2
templates.reason: A confirmed flagrant foul—penalty two carrying the minimum automatic fine.

templates.name: Physical Contact with an Official
templates.reason: Deliberate or aggressive physical contact with a game official.

templates.name: Verbal Abuse of an Official
templates.reason: Abusive, threatening, or sustained non-physical misconduct directed at a game official.

templates.name: Dangerous Physical Act
templates.reason: Striking, kicking, kneeing, elbowing, or another reckless physical act that created a serious injury risk.

templates.name: Fighting / Punching
templates.reason: Initiating, escalating, or materially participating in an on-court fight or punching incident.

templates.name: Leaving Bench — Active Involvement
templates.reason: Leaving the immediate bench area during an altercation and actively participating in or escalating the incident.

templates.name: Leaving Bench — No Active Involvement
templates.reason: Leaving the immediate bench area during an altercation without actively joining the fight.

templates.name: Unsportsmanlike Conduct
templates.reason: Serious unsportsmanlike conduct beyond the ordinary in-game penalty.

templates.name: Taunting / Obscene Gesture
templates.reason: Taunting, an obscene gesture, or inappropriate language directed at an opponent, official, spectator, or broadcast audience.

templates.name: Ball Thrown into Stands
templates.reason: Throwing or kicking the ball into the spectator area with force outside the normal course of play.

templates.name: Flopping
templates.reason: A confirmed flopping violation subject to league discipline.

templates.name: Public Criticism of Officials
templates.reason: Public comments that improperly attacked the integrity, competence, or impartiality of game officials.

templates.name: Social Media Misconduct
templates.reason: Inappropriate, threatening, or harmful social-media activity that violated league conduct standards.

templates.name: Conduct Detrimental to the League
templates.reason: Conduct detrimental to the league or professional basketball that damaged competitive integrity, safety, or public trust.

templates.name: Public Misconduct
templates.reason: Public behavior that brought the player, team, or league into disrepute.

templates.name: Unauthorized Gambling
templates.reason: Unauthorized wagering or gambling-related activity that threatened league integrity.

templates.name: Inside Information Leak
templates.reason: Providing confidential team, player, injury, or strategy information for wagering or improper competitive use.

templates.name: Harassment / Bullying
templates.reason: Harassment, bullying, threats, or repeated abusive conduct toward a league participant.

templates.name: Discriminatory Conduct
templates.reason: Discriminatory remarks or conduct that violated league workplace and public-behavior standards.

templates.name: Domestic Violence
templates.reason: A substantiated domestic-violence incident or related criminal disposition requiring league discipline.

templates.name: Weapon Misconduct
templates.reason: Possessing, storing, displaying, or threatening another person with a weapon in violation of league safety standards.

templates.name: Criminal Assault
templates.reason: A serious off-court assault or violent criminal incident supported by an investigation, plea, or conviction.

templates.name: Personal Conduct Violation
templates.reason: Serious personal misconduct requiring league discipline after review of the available evidence.

templates.name: Conduct Detrimental to the Team
templates.reason: Conduct that disrupted team operations or materially damaged the organization.

templates.name: Missed Team Activity
templates.reason: Unexcused absence from a required practice, workout, meeting, shootaround, treatment session, or team event.

templates.name: Insubordination
templates.reason: Repeated refusal to follow reasonable instructions from coaches or team officials.
